snippet.title: The Voice of Cards Trilogy | Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
The Voice of Cards games are a series of enchanting turn-based RPGs where the whole world is depicted through the medium of cards.

The Voice of Cards Trilogy brings together all three games from the series; “The Isle Dragon Roars”, “The Forsaken Maiden” and “The Beasts of Burden” in one extra-value set. 

Available now as a trilogy on Steam, Nintendo Switch, Playstation 4!
A “Voice of Cards Trilogy + DLC set” is also available.
